purpose: Persist operator structural rules independently of any conversation and propagate them into ChaCha DEV governance.

directives.normalized_requirement: Every materialized component must have a canonical birth contract and pass the Universal Materialization Gate before ACTIVE.
Fleet, Guardian, Assurance, lifecycle and hygiene must derive their governed inventory from one canonical component registry.
Active platform logic must decide by capabilities, contracts, schemas or metadata rather than V7/V8/V9 major-version literals when a generic mechanism exists.
Lifecycle, retention and purge must cover releases, agents, objects, adapters, runtimes, temporaries and terminal Guardian state without circular dependency on the component being repaired.
When an incident reveals a missing general rule, repair the root cause and promote the correction into a permanent invariant that prevents recurrence.
Guardian and Sentinel must never be bypassed; blocked paths require root-cause repair rather than synthetic PASS or authority escalation.
Automatic external spend is zero unless the operator explicitly authorizes a paid action.
Do not replay previously acquired PASS qualifications when the exact HEAD and affected scope have not changed.
Continue automatically across authorized non-blocking internal steps and stop only at real human boundaries or unresolved external conditions.
Structural operator instructions must be durably captured before downstream execution and must not be considered applied until architecture propagation is VERIFIED and ACTIVE.

When the operator supplies a verified immutable existing candidate and requests resume, publish or qualify without reconstruction, validate worktree, revision, tree and lineage and continue the candidate lifecycle without creating a synthetic project or Domain Factory graph.

Whenever work is performed through ChaCha DEV, global progress and per-module progress bars remain persistently available across supported operator surfaces, reconnects and sessions; future user-visible long-running components inherit the progress reporting contract.

Every ChaCha DEV platform promotion is owned by exactly one lease-bound writer; current switching and terminalization use governed-platform-promotion, promotion receipts are immutable/write-once, transaction history is append-only, expired ownership requires controlled same-owner recovery, and Reconciler/Intendant cannot mutate protected state concurrently. Recovery must preserve a root lease lineage and may reuse immutable receipts from ancestor leases only for the same promotion_id and exact candidate revision, without replaying materially unchanged evidence. Owner, promotion scope or candidate revision may never change during recovery. When physical release retention is already at its limit, Intendant must reserve one governed staging slot before candidate materialization, preserving active production and the primary rollback; activation fails closed if the physical release limit is exceeded.

ChaCha DEV must continuously convert only evidence-backed and globally useful competitive, Technology Watch and verified Technology Truth improvements into governed shadow update trains. Internal reuse is preferred; compatible open-source code may be reused with provenance, license, attribution, copyleft/patent and SBOM obligations; otherwise ChaCha reconstructs the mechanism itself. Plugins/connectors are fallback-only when an owned implementation is not reasonably feasible. Novelty alone never justifies a component. Every train must demonstrate measurable platform value and architectural fit before build. Qualified trains appear in the Cockpit Update Center with functional/value/risk/license/dependency explanations. The operator may request one or all compatible promotions; UI actions only start the governed promotion pipeline and never bypass Guardian, Sentinel, UMG, CCR, rollback, exact-SHA qualification or human production authority.

All authorized ChaCha DEV observation, assurance, intelligence, learning, benchmark and operator-directive agents must contribute evidence to one federated Improvement Intelligence Fabric. No single collector owns platform evolution. Signals are normalized, deduplicated, corroborated and value-gated; novelty alone never justifies a train. Only the central orchestrator may hand an approved improvement axis to the Creation Runtime/Foundries. Open-source reuse is permitted only when provenance and license obligations are compatible; otherwise rebuild the mechanism. Every promoted platform update refreshes a living white paper covering runtime-observed architecture, functional rationale, limitations, roadmap, competitive comparison, business model and valuation scenarios. The Direct Operator Cockpit exposes governed Update Center and White Paper entry points. Production remains human-gated.

Every ChaCha DEV update train must have a sealed reproducible recipe. A train may be shelved without losing Git history, evidence, dependencies or reconstruction instructions. Shelved trains remain visible in Update Center and may be rehydrated after current-policy revalidation. Physical retirement is a separate Intendant-governed destructive action: never active, rollback or leased material; Guardian destructive PRE and explicit human approval are mandatory. Recipe and Git history survive physical retirement.

Capabilities created from technology, competitive, dark-intelligence or other improvement signals are packaged as recipe-first PLATFORM_PLUGIN components by default, not fused into the core. Every plugin has a sealed manifest, exact source, permissions, dependency/conflict graph, qualification evidence and rollback contract. Install rebuilds and verifies on demand. Disable must precede uninstall and platform health must be verified. Uninstall removes runtime material only; recipe, Git, evidence and persistent data survive by default. Persistent-data deletion is a separate destructive gate. Core authority components remain CORE_LOCKED and cannot be disabled or uninstalled through Plugin Center. Core mutation is exceptional and requires Architecture Council justification. If a capability is explicitly approved and promoted as a structural core update, it leaves plugin lifecycle permanently: record MERGED_INTO_CORE_LOCKED, expose no disable/uninstall/reinstall action, and evolve it only through a new governed core train, governed supersession or governed release rollback.

External consultants use individual authenticated identities and may converse with ChaCha and build only inside their own guest project namespace. They have no access to the ChaCha DEV platform project, core, agents, Foundries, Guardian/Sentinel controls, STOP, platform updates or production authority. They may not query ChaCha DEV internals; the Living White Paper is the only authorized platform document. Global session/progress, internal receipts, runtime paths, Technology Watch and central memory are not exposed. Consultant requests never become operator structural directives or platform improvement signals.
